# DK AI Marketplace

> Marketplace for AI builders and buyers. Sell AI agents, automations and prompts, commission custom AI work, and book consultations with verified experts.

DK AI Marketplace connects independent AI builders with buyers who need ready-made AI products or custom work. Sellers keep 95% of revenue; buyers pay securely via Stripe.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the marketplace and founding-seller program.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Browse AI agents, automations, and prompts.
- [Top Products](/top-products): Highest-rated and trending AI products.
- [Top Sellers](/top-sellers): Leading AI builders on the platform.
- [Community](/community): Discussions on AI tooling, builds, and questions.
- [Feed](/feed): Latest community activity.
- [Statistics](/statistics): Platform stats and metrics.
- [Achievements](/achievements): Seller rank and achievement system.
- [Legal](/legal): Terms, privacy, and policy documents.

## Optional

- [Sign up](/signup): Create a buyer or seller account.
- [Log in](/login): Existing account access.
